Stay current with product enhancements, release notes, feature changes, and emerging network technologies. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to align customer objectives, meet service delivery goals, and support continuous process improvements. Contribute field insights to Real Time Networks retrospectives, improving delivery, support, and overall customer experience. Experience with IoT devices, RFID systems, or security access control technology is a strong asset. Technical Skills Networking: Strong understanding of LAN/WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls, certificate management, and security protocols. Maybe you worked on power systems at a FSAE Electric team and went pro. Maybe you've been at a defense startup or eVTOL company where you owned a subsystem end to end. Veterans With Technical or Operational Depth You served and you're looking to stay in the fight from the builder side. Maybe you were a combat engineer, Special Operations, EOD, fire controlman, or had a technical MOS/rate. Maybe you ran operations or logistics in environments where things had to work the first time. Defense Business Operations Proposal managers, capture managers, contract administrators, or BD professionals who have actually won contracts with Army, Navy, Marines, or MDA. IDIQ and OTA experience is a plus. If you've only worked commercial or big-company BD where a team of 40 touches a single proposal, we're probably not the right fit.
